text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Sept 10 - Bombay - Closed 16/9 for holiday. Occasional rain hampered cargo operations in the port. Ten vessels loading at berth, 17 discharging, 10 discharging at anchorage. 7 Waiting at anchor load, 20 to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 5 under repair, 3 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, containers 2-3 days, bulkers 5-6 days, general cargo 8-10 days. Calcutta - Seven vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering, 20 due. Berthing delays, products tankers 11 days, palm oil/phosphoric acid 1 day, containers 2 days, met coke 4 days.

Cochin - Five vessels operating of which 2 containers, 2 break bulk (loading/discharging), 1 fertiliser discharging. Delays expected, Break bulk (loading/discharging)/fertiliser discharging/fertiliser (rock phosphate/sulphur) discharging up to 1 day, steel/grain/coal/sugar (discharging) up to 1 day depending on receiver's readiness to accept direct delivery. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage, 2 at shipyard dry-dock. Mormugao - Two vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 3 Under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. Vessels due and berthing delays expected, 1 molasses with 1-2 days delay, 15 ore with 4-5 days delay. Kandla - Four vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging, 1 discharging at anchorage. 7 Waiting at anchorage to load, 4 to discharge. 3 Tankers berthed, 19 waiting. Berthing delays, steel coils/blocks/rice 4-5 days, soda ash/hdpe/bentonite 7-8 days.

Mangalore - One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting, 1 under arrest. Vessels due and delays expected, 3 to load iron ore concentrate/pellets with 1-2 days delay, 1 to discharge sulphur, 1 to load general cargo, 3 to load granite blocks, 3 to discharge chemical, all with up to 1 day's delay. Madras - Five vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging. 19 Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 30 due (5 coal/coke, 5 edible oil, 11 containers, 1 scrap, 6 general cargo, 1 bulker, 1 iron ore). Delays coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser 3-4 days, scrap 5-6 days, others 3-4 days, no delays for containers/iron ore.

Jawaharlal Nehru - Two vessels discharging at berth (fertiliser/raw materials), 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage. 1 Tanker/iron ore, 3 fertiliser/raw materials vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge. 5 Fertiliser/raw materials due with 20-22 days berthing delay, 4 tanker/iron ore due with 2-3 days delay expected. Paradip - Four vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 due with no delays expected. Monsoon weather, but no major delays in bulk cargo operations. Tuticorin - Five vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchor to discharge. 8 Due with 1-2 days delay expected. Visakhapatnam - Five vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging 7 waiting at anchor to discharge at inner harbour berth. Delays, granite blocks/soymeal (export) 3-4 days, dap (import) 10-12 days, coking coal (import) 7-8 days, full containers, rbd palmolein, empty/full containers (all import) 1-2 days, rock phosphate (import) up to 1 day. No vessels designated to lift bunkers. Any bunkers required can be effected at cargo berths at inner/outer harbour by barge or truck.

MALAYSIA Sept 11 - Port Kelang - North port container berths - 2 Vessels berthed, 1 berthing today. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 vessels berthing today, 3 vessels waiting with 3 days waiting time expected. Dry bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 5 days waiting time expected. West port - 4 Conventional vessels, 2 cement carriers berthed, 1 wharf occupied by passenger vessel, 1 days waiting time expected.

PAKISTAN, Sept 9 - Karachi - One rice vessel loading at berth, 3 container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 9 vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, dap, sugar, fertiliser, hsd). 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (sugar, fuel oil, containers). 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 3 vessels due with up to 24 hours delay expected.

PHILIPPINES, Sept 9 - Manila - South harbour - 13 Vessels discharging at berth, 10 discharging at anchorage, 4 vessels waiting at outer anchorage to discharge. Average waiting times vessels with draft less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres 1-2 days, vessels with a draft greater than 9 metres and an loa greater than 140 metres 2-3 days. Occasional monsoon rains.

SINGAPORE, Sept 10 - Tanjong pagar container terminal - 4 Vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 10 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 9 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 2 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 3 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 18 Tankers berthed, minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys. Widespread rain expected over the next few days pre-dawn and morning.

SRI LANKA, Sept 10 - Colombo - No labour problems. Heavy rains. 13 vessels loading at berth (3 breakbulk, 10 containers), 20 discharging (1 lpg, 1 bagged cement, 2 general cargo, 3 bagged rice, 1 bagged wheat flour, 1 bulk palm oil products, 1 bulk fertiliser, 10 containers). 8 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (5 containers, 1 rice, 1 sugar, 1 general cargo) 2 bunkering outside harbour. 9 Under repair/dry-docked, 7 awaiting orders, 5 due, 1-2 days delay. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - No vessels operating.

SOUTH KOREA, Sept 10 - Inchon - 95 Vessels in port (51 berthed, 44 anchored) of which berthed, 9 logs, 5 general cargo, 4 scrap, 3 steel, 3 corn, 2 tapioca, 2 soya bean meal, 2 rapemeal, 2 rice, 2 pulp, 2 containers, 1 cement, 1 ingots, 1 steel plate, 1 pig-iron, 1 steel billets, 1 coils, 1 rape blending pellets, 1 soda, 1 timber, 1 cars, 1 palm oil, 1 ply-wood, 1 wheat, 1 molasses, 1 silica sand. Vessels anchored, 7 general cargo, 5 scrap, 5 cars, 4 plywood, 4 containers, 3 corn, 2 logs, 2 soymeal, 2 coils, 1 rape pellets, 1 talc, 1 rye, 1 pig-iron, 1 pulp, 1 steel, 1 molasses, 1 wheat, 1 steel plate, 1 timber. Approx 5 days delay expected.

Busan - 175 Vessels in port (51 berthed, 124 anchored including 61 laid-up) of which berthed 36 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 63 awaiting berth with approx 3-4 days delay expected. Pohang - 20 Vessels in port (15 berthed, 5 anchored) of which berthed discharging 2 iron ore, 2 coal, 2 billets, 1 perlite, 1 scrap, 1 clinker, 1 steel products, 1 pipes. 4 Steel vessels loading, 5 awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay. Ulsan - 29 In port (20 berthed, 9 anchored) of which discharging 4 feed meal, 2 woodchip, 2 crude, 1 ammonia, 1 styrene monomer, 1 sugar, 1 steel plates, 1 xylene, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 corn. Loading 2 general cargo, 1 chemicals. 9 Vessels (6 feed, 3 others) awaiting berths approx. 3-15 days delay for feed vessels. Masan - Eight vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging 2 logs, 2 cement, 1 tapioca, 1 rice, 1 containers. 1 Container vessel loading, no delays expected.

TAIWAN, Sept 7 - Keelung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays coal 8 days, steel/iron ore 3 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 4 days, iron/coal 3 days (csc berth), coal/scrap 1 day (public berth), steel 1 day. Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Delays grain/iron ore/coal/steel/others 1-2 days, no delays for scrap. Kaohsiung, Sept 9 - 64 Vessels in port of which 14 containers, 3 tankers, 2 grain, 2 other bulkers, 30 general cargo, 13 at buoys. 1 Grain vessel waiting at outer anchorage, 5 days berthing delay.
THAILAND, Sept 9 - Bangkok - 90 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 1 tanker, 84 other bulkers/general cargo vessels, 4 vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
